findings.problem: Na ja is just as natural a resigned, shrugging well before so ist das Leben, and the hint rules out only also, so it leaves two right answers; also, writing the German word also in an English hint could read as English also.
findings.fix: hint: a one-syllable resigned shrug (not na ja or the German also)

back.target: well (a resigned or thoughtful interjection, said with a shrug)

note: Spanish bueno-well-okay is a filler for starting a reply, not a resigned shrug, so it is right that sameAs is null; it is null anyway because this is a glue card.
